The published Claim contract does not declare it (additionalProperties false) and nothing on the auction path validated claims against that contract, so two otherwise identical stores - one adding the string - gave the liar the ENTIRE shortlist while the honest store was excluded. It also set verified_hard_fit_count, the FIRST published tie-break, so the lie won ties as well as filters. Ignoring store-supplied status alone would make every hard-constrained auction return an EMPTY shortlist, because nothing produced a verified claim on the auction path - a denial of service, not a repair. The lane built attested verdicts the store cannot write (apps/exchange/src/ranking/attestation.py) and the fixtures now ask for the same verdict through the exchange own door instead of writing the word. VERIFIED, NOT ASSERTED. Frozen suite 112/120 before the patch and 120/120 after, measured on this tree minutes apart. e8_proofs_passing stays 8. THE PRODUCT IMPORT IS INSIDE THE FUNCTION, per this directory module-scope rule, and the builders say so. Three gates bind on it and all pass. Fixing that needs an ASSERTION changed inside the freeze (test_e3_exchange.py:643), which this authorization explicitly does not cover, so it is being escalated separately rather than folded in here.
